## Workload

Elif Sahin completed 172 reads over 252 hours of grading. This represents a rate of 0.7 reads per hour. The recorded workload provides the basis for the review of the grading activity and its associated quality results.

## Quality

A total of 20 reads were checked as part of the review. Agreement between the grading and review assessments was 55.0 per cent. The findings were considered alongside the recorded workload and the existing session pattern.

The grader and reviewer agreed to keep the current session pattern. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
